review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for the declaration names it introduces: integral_countable, integral_fintype, setIntegral_finset, setIntegral_countable, integral_count, integral_sum_measure, hasSum_integral_measure, integrable_sum_measure and the dirac variants. I found no independent competing declarations. The file's only other uses are in Probability/Moments/Basic.lean, Prokhorov.lean and Probability/ProbabilityMassFunction/Integrals.lean, which call into it. The lintegral analogues in Lebesgue/Countable.lean and Lebesgue/Basic.lean are for a different integral (ℝ≥0∞-valued) and are parallel API, not duplicates. The Dirac-specialised lemmas are named specialisations of the general sum-measure results, which the rubric treats as acceptable. I did not search exhaustively for every possible alternative formulation, such as PMF integral lemmas or Finset-sum measure integrals, so a small residual uncertainty remains.
